\section[(dialogue)]{The body, health and family — a first pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R37-first-pass-the-body-health-and-family}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a desk and a roof.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a nail, an elbow, a knee, the throat, the chest
  \item a bone, the chin, a cheek, an eyebrow, skin
  \item sweat, tears, a voice, a fever, painful
  \item medicine, sleepy, sad, fun, scary
  \item pain, a grandfather, an uncle, a son, a daughter
  \item a friend, an adult, a man, a woman, a teacher
  \item next door; a neighbour, a companion, to go, to buy, to drink
  \item to read, to write, to speak, to wait, to meet
  \item to use, to sing, to say, to think, to hold
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A nail? (\emph{tsume}.) An elbow? (\emph{hiji}.) A knee? (\emph{hiza}.) The throat? (\emph{nodo}.) The chest? (\emph{mune}.) A bone? (\emph{hone}.) The chin? (\emph{ago}.) A cheek? (\emph{hoo}.) An eyebrow? (\emph{mayu}.) Skin? (\emph{hada}.) Sweat? (\emph{ase}.) Tears? (\emph{namida}.) A voice? (\emph{koe}.) A fever? (\emph{netsu}.) Painful? (\emph{itai}.) Medicine? (\emph{kusuri}.) Sleepy? (\emph{nemui}.) Sad? (\emph{kanashii}.) Fun? (\emph{tanoshii}.) Scary? (\emph{kowai}.) Pain? (\emph{itami}.) A grandfather? (\emph{ojiisan}.) An uncle? (\emph{ojisan}.) A son? (\emph{musuko}.) A daughter? (\emph{musume}.) A friend? (\emph{tomodachi}.) An adult? (\emph{otona}.) A man? (\emph{otoko}.) A woman? (\emph{onna}.) A teacher? (\emph{sensei}.) Next door; a neighbour? (\emph{tonari}.) A companion? (\emph{nakama}.) To go? (\emph{iku}.) To buy? (\emph{kau}.) To drink? (\emph{nomu}.) To read? (\emph{yomu}.) To write? (\emph{kaku}.) To speak? (\emph{hanasu}.) To wait? (\emph{matsu}.) To meet? (\emph{au}.) To use? (\emph{tsukau}.) To sing? (\emph{utau}.) To say? (\emph{iu}.) To think? (\emph{omou}.) To hold? (\emph{motsu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

  \item to take out, to drop, to fix, to move, rice; a meal
  \item a fish, meat, an egg, vegetables, fruit
  \item an apple, a mandarin orange, a strawberry, a peach, a pear
  \item a watermelon, a white radish, a carrot, tofu, salt
  \item sugar, udon noodles, sushi, breakfast, sweets
  \item seaweed, a Japanese plum, a chestnut, beans, uncooked rice

To stand? (\emph{tatsu}.) To cry? (\emph{naku}.) To live? (\emph{sumu}.) To rest? (\emph{yasumu}.) To enjoy? (\emph{tanoshimu}.) To push? (\emph{osu}.) To pull? (\emph{hiku}.) To look for? (\emph{sagasu}.) To lend? (\emph{kasu}.) To give back? (\emph{kaesu}.) To take out? (\emph{dasu}.) To drop? (\emph{otosu}.) To fix? (\emph{naosu}.) To move? (\emph{ugoku}.) Rice; a meal? (\emph{gohan}.) A fish? (\emph{sakana}.) Meat? (\emph{niku}.) An egg? (\emph{tamago}.) Vegetables? (\emph{yasai}.) Fruit? (\emph{kudamono}.) An apple? (\emph{ringo}.) A mandarin orange? A Japanese plum? (\emph{ume}.) A chestnut? (\emph{kuri}.) Beans? (\emph{mame}.) Uncooked rice? (\emph{kome}.) Home? (\emph{uchi}.) A window? (\emph{mado}.) A chair? (\emph{isu}.) A desk?
